behavioralContracts.bootstrap: AppFactory::create enables defaults. createFromContainer uses external PSR-11 services and leaves defaults disabled until opted in.
behavioralContracts.middleware: FIFO for user middleware. Configure parsers before an explicit routing endpoint. Group middleware wraps route middleware.
behavioralContracts.urlGeneration: Named routes are resolved at lookup time. URL generation encodes parameters once and includes the configured base path.
behavioralContracts.container: Shared lazy values include null. Missing entries and construction failures use distinct PSR-11 classifications.
behavioralContracts.responseEmission: Suppress content on 1xx, 204, 205 and 304. Strip Content-Length on 1xx and 204. Normalize an explicit 205 Content-Length to zero.
behavioralContracts.requestHandler: Custom PSR-15 endpoints including independent Router instances execute inside application middleware.
